{{Quote|People complain all the time, and it's all most people know about nerfs, but I grew up on this ranch and never spent much time anywhere else. If nerfs smell bad, I don't know what smells good!|Vreet Harak|<ref name="Mountain Nerf">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030206nerf|series=Creature Feature|text=Mountain Nerf}}</ref>}}
'''Vreet Harak''' was a third-generation [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Nerf herder/Legends|nerf herder]] who worked for the [[Grand Horn Ranch Corporation]] on [[Fennesa/Legends|Fennesa]]. He had the appearance of a typical [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] herder and did not smell that nice.
